httpComparison.method: Six fresh processes; alternating registration order; paired log mean-time ratios with 95% t intervals, df=5.
httpComparison.limits: Approximate independent log-normal trial model, shared capped host. CI containing one is inconclusive, not equivalence. No timing gate.

limits: Selected literal outputs are qualified; full Hono/service/gateway lifecycle equivalence is not.
Same-engine adapters do not independently validate parser grammars.
Six trials share one capped host; CI containing one is inconclusive, not equivalence.
Warm Fetch dispatch and response consumption exclude network listeners, construction and joined per-request cleanup.
Single-run alternative/cost-reference timing summaries establish no comparative significance.
No hosted CI, registry publication, full Bun/browser qualification or cross-computer persistence is claimed.
sourceGateDigestScope: 815 Git-visible files frozen for qualification and measurements; the two generated comparison receipt files are excluded.
